rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_support then northstar_commerce table, then drops support_access_log, support_access_grant, support_message, support_case and the northstar_support schema (CASCADE), followed by ad_placement, entitlement_grant, refund, payment_event, purchase, offer, product and the northstar_commerce schema (CASCADE). purchase/entitlement_grant hold commercial evidence and support_case/support_message hold governed contact records, so on a shared environment export the schemas first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_commerce schema with product, offer, purchase, payment_event, refund, entitlement_grant and ad_placement tables exists
northstar_support schema with support_case, support_message, support_access_grant and support_access_log tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_commerce and northstar_support table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 7 commerce + support modules (offers over the existing entitlement engine, signature-verified idempotent payment callbacks, refunds, ad disclosure; validated support intake, case lifecycle, and audited time-bounded support-access grants) baseline
